# DECK — Plan. Track. Achieve.

> DECK is the minimal control center for marketing teams to plan campaigns, track goals by channel, and achieve outcomes.

## What DECK does
- **Projects:** Every client or campaign as a project (Q3 Launch — Acme)
- **Goals:** By channel — Social Media, Paid Ads, SEO, Content, Email — with targets and progress
- **Tasks:** Linked to goals, due dates, assignees, status (To do / In progress / Done)
- **Features:** Metrics, milestones, files, comments, activity timeline, calendar

## Who it's for
Creators, founders, marketers who need clarity over clutter. No decoration, every element has purpose.

## Why DECK
- Professional, premium, minimal, confident, modern, AI-first (when useful, not for show)
- Deep Charcoal #0B0F14, Violet #7C5CFF, clean Inter typography
- Plan. Track. Achieve.
